candidates.change_summary: Change transfer of full balance to transfer only half of contract balance to Owner (dividing by 2).
Remove the require that only Owner can call withdraw, allowing anyone to trigger the transfer to Owner.
Change transfer target from Owner to msg.sender so withdraw sends the balance to the caller instead of the Owner.
Transfer zero wei to Owner (no funds moved), leaving contract balance unchanged after withdraw.
Reorder statements: perform transfer before checking that caller is Owner (allows non-owners to trigger transfer if Owner is payable target).
